about: Krish's rulings on the wording of a rejection floor record, kept over every rebuild of config/rejection-floor.json. The Rejections engine (krishanraja/inspirationhouse) rebuilds that file from records that cannot be edited once written; scripts/floor_rulings.py applies each ruling below when any reader here loads the floor. A ruling replaces a field only while it still holds one of the wordings in replaces (or already the ruled one); any other wording is reported, never overwritten. Each entry carries the ruling line and his words. Changed only by a pull request that carries his ruling.
